final: WITH department_counts AS (SELECT major.department AS department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member JOIN major ON major.major_id = member.link_to_major GROUP BY major.department), shares AS (SELECT department, member_count, CAST(member_count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(member_count) FROM department_counts) AS share FROM department_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT shares.department, shares.member_count, shares.share, shares.share - average_share.avg_share FROM shares CROSS JOIN average_share WHERE shares.share > average_share.avg_share
